queries:
SELECT AVG(avg_price), AVG(line_count)
FROM (
  SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS line_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
  HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0
);
SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM (SELECT AVG(product_price) AS avg_price FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0)) AS avg_of_invoice_avg_price,
  (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number)) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice;
SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
FROM Invoice_Line_Items
WHERE product_price IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY invoice_number;
SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE product_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY invoice_number)
SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT i.invoice_number, COUNT(l.order_item_id) AS cnt FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON i.invoice_number = l.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number)
SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_line_item_count, AVG(mean_price) AS avg_mean_price
FROM (
  SELECT i.invoice_number, COUNT(l.order_item_id) AS cnt, AVG(l.product_price) AS mean_price
  FROM Invoices i
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON i.invoice_number = l.invoice_number
  GROUP BY i.invoice_number
);
